name: job-application-tracker
description: Personal job application tracker and analyzer (React + Express + Supabase + Claude).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @jat/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @jat/shared" "npm run dev -w @jat/server" "npm run dev -w @jat/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @jat/server && npm run build -w @jat/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @jat/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
